description: All tickers consumed by hicp_fixings.py. Single source of truth — the Python module reads tickers directly from this file.

historical_series.label: HICP Headline
historical_series.haver_note: Haver holds the YoY rate (CPIEZM@EUDATA) but not the index level. Use Bloomberg for levels.
historical_series.description: Euro Area HICP Headline index level

historical_series.label: HICP ex Tobacco
historical_series.haver_note: Not available as an index level on Haver. Use Bloomberg.
historical_series.description: HICP excluding tobacco — settlement index for all EUR HICPxT inflation swaps

historical_series.label: HICP Core
historical_series.haver_note: YoY available as CPIEZXFE@EUDATA and CPIXEFAM@EUDATA. Index level not confirmed in Haver.
historical_series.description: HICP excluding food, alcohol, tobacco and energy

historical_series.label: Core Goods
historical_series.haver_note: YoY available as CPINEIM@EUDATA. Index level not confirmed.

historical_series.label: Services
historical_series.haver_note: YoY available as CPIESVM@EUDATA. Index level not confirmed.

historical_series.label: HICP Energy
historical_series.haver_note: YoY available as CPIENRM@EUDATA. Index level not confirmed.

historical_series.label: Food incl. A&T
historical_series.haver_note: YoY available as CPIFOAM@EUDATA. Index level not confirmed.
historical_series.description: HICP food including alcohol and tobacco

f_series.description: EUR HICPxT F-series calendar-month fixings. n = calendar month (1=Jan…12=Dec). Bloomberg PX_LAST = implied YoY %. Covers the 12-month cycle starting ~1 year ahead of today.

t_series.description: EUR HICPxT T-series calendar-month fixings. Covers the following 12-month cycle. Level reconstruction uses F-series reconstructed levels as the base.
